gaps: Tax structure: NY levies a state excise plus a local rate, and the THC potency tax was repealed in 2024. Confirm current rates from the NYS Department of Taxation and Finance before any tax sentence ships. Do not carry over the pre-repeal structure.
Operating store count: licenses issued far exceeds stores open. OCM publishes a dispensary location list that gives a truer open-store number for market-size claims.
Queens borough aggregation, see the note on ny-nyc-dispensary-concentration.
Legalization and first-sale dates: MRTA (2021) and the first legal sale (late 2022) both need primary citations.
